top_signals.title: Italy Buffalo Mozzarella Output Halted by Trucker Protests
top_signals.summary: Trucker protests over soaring fuel prices in Italy have forced dairies in the country’s south to stop making their prized buffalo mozzarella, in the latest sign of mounting economic and political frustration.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
